column1: # Declared, intended differences between the platforms' test inventories.
# M2-K12. `check-test-inventory.sh` refuses any test that exists on one
# platform and not the other, or is silenced on one and not the other. A
# divergence that is genuinely intended belongs HERE, in the diff, with a
# reason a reviewer can weigh — never as a `#[cfg]` on the test, which makes
# The reason is mandatory; an entry without one is refused.
# Empty on purpose. Every test in the workspace compiles in on both platforms.
